Markets.title: How to trade PB Fintech shares after falling 12% from day’s high? This technical analyst explains
Markets.summary: PB Fintech shares dropped another 5% on Friday, extending a sharp selloff driven by weak technical momentum and brokerages lowering their price targets. The decline follows concerns that proposed regulatory changes by the IRDAI could negatively impact Policybazaar's earnings.

Markets.title: Balrampur Chini Mills shares rally 4% as company receives Rs 75 crore BioE3 grant from government
Markets.summary: Balrampur Chini Mills shares rallied 4% after the company received a Rs 75 crore government grant. The funding will be used to build a polylactic acid co-polymer research and development facility in Uttar Pradesh.

Markets.title: Global Market: Hong Kong stocks slide as investors await Trump-Xi summit details
Markets.summary: Hong Kong stocks fell sharply on Friday, led by declines of 1.7% in the Hang Seng and over 2% in the Hang Seng Tech Index. Investors sold off shares as they awaited clarity on U.S.-China relations following the Trump-Xi summit.

Markets.title: OFSS shares tumble 5% after Oracle sends 'force majeure' notice for data centre project. Are AI worries coming true?
Markets.summary: Oracle Financial Services Software shares dropped over 5% to a nine-week low of Rs 10,332 following a force majeure notice from parent company Oracle regarding a New Mexico AI data centre project. This development raised financing concerns for AI infrastructure projects.

Markets.title: Nebius shares rally up to 8%: What’s driving the AI rally?
Markets.summary: Nebius shares rallied up to 8% after BNP Paribas upgraded the stock and raised its price target. The surge is also driven by planned AI cloud price hikes that are fueling growth expectations despite the company's continued losses and elevated valuation.

Markets.title: IPO multibagger ESDS shares hit 5% lower circuit as Q1 net profit more than halves. Time to sell?
Markets.summary: ESDS Software Solution shares hit a 5% lower circuit at Rs 1,758 after its Q1 FY27 net profit dropped 57% sequentially to Rs 29.3 crore. Analysts advise new investors to avoid the high valuations and recommend that current shareholders book partial profits.

Geo-Political.title: US and China must act as responsible powers together, Xi says as Trump toasts friendship at state dinner

Geo-Political.summary: President Xi Jinping received a warm official welcome from President Trump during his visit. However, China did not achieve its desired concessions regarding trade, technology, and Taiwan.

Geo-Political.title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu defended his military actions during an address to the UN General Assembly. He condemned the delegates who walked out before his speech as "moral cowards."

Geo-Political.summary: CNN and MS NOW reporters were blocked from covering a White House state dinner despite a judge's ruling that their press passes must be restored. The news outlets stated this denial directly violated the court order regarding their access.

Data & Insights.title: Cabinet to soon decide on new bilateral investment treaty template to ease dispute settlements
Data & Insights.summary: The Cabinet will soon decide on a new bilateral investment treaty template designed to ease dispute settlements. The proposed model will significantly reduce the five-year mandatory litigation timeframe required before companies can pursue global arbitration.

Data & Insights.title: India-Mexico may sign trade pact, report reveals: Autos, pharma, engineering—who stands to gain?
Data & Insights.summary: India and Mexico plan to finalize terms for a preferential trade agreement in early October to improve market access and trade facilitation. This agreement could boost Indian exports in the automotive and pharmaceutical sectors despite impending import tariffs.

Data & Insights.title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund loans cross  ₹1 trillion as Centre targets post-harvest efficiency
Data & Insights.summary: Loans under the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund have surpassed ₹1 trillion to improve post-harvest efficiency. Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, and Gujarat are the top five beneficiary states, with individual farmers accounting for nearly 59% of approved projects.

Data & Insights.title: Centre cuts import duty on edible oils to curb price rise
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has reduced import duties on edible oils to lower procurement costs for cooking oils. This reduction aims to decrease retail prices for consumers if supply chain intermediaries pass on the savings.

Data & Insights.title: PM’s principal secretary flags risks from trade barriers, volatile capital
Data & Insights.summary: India's principal secretary Pramod Kumar Mishra warned that the country cannot depend on favorable global conditions despite its economic stability and growth. He specifically highlighted potential risks from rising trade barriers and volatile capital flows.

Data & Insights.title: Rupee has a fair case to appreciate: RBI DG Poonam Gupta
Data & Insights.summary: Reserve Bank of India Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta states that the rupee's recent depreciation is likely temporary. She attributes this to India's strong underlying balance of payments, suggesting the currency has a fair case to appreciate.

India.title: Assam Government Raises Orunodoi Scheme Assistance To Rs 1,500 For October As Durga Puja Gift
India.summary: The Assam government increased Orunodoi scheme financial assistance to Rs 1,500 for October as a Durga Puja gift. The Cabinet also approved October 17, 2026, as an additional holiday, bringing the total number of notified Durga Puja holidays to five.

India.title: SSC Combined Graduate Level Exam: Admit Card Soon, Exam From Sep 30
India.summary: The Staff Selection Commission will soon release the admit cards for the Combined Graduate Level Exam 2026. The examination is scheduled to take place nationwide from September 30 to October 30, 2026.

India.title: Court Allows 7 Arrested Foreigners To Travel Abroad For A Month
India.summary: An Indian court permitted seven arrested foreigners to travel abroad for one month. The court ordered them to return to India and notify authorities within 72 hours of their return.

India.title: Assam Approves Rules For Compulsory Registration Of Muslim Marriages
India.summary: Assam has approved new rules requiring the compulsory registration of Muslim marriages by government registrars. Chief Minister Himanta Sarma announced the policy change to formalize marriage documentation in the state.

India.title: "Will Deal With You": Karnataka Congress MLA Alleges Threat From Party Leader
India.summary: Karnataka Congress MLA Yashwantharayagowda Patil resigned because Indi and Chadachan taluks were excluded from the drought-hit list. During the Assembly discussion on this matter, Patil alleged that another party leader threatened him.

India.title: IIT Delhi Researchers Develop India's First Micro-Graphics Processing Unit
India.summary: Researchers at IIT Delhi have developed India's first micro-Graphics Processing Unit (GPU). This new architecture is designed to power indigenous graphics and display systems for embedded applications like artificial intelligence and machine learning.
